summary: Two loader tractors head to auction inside the radius: a one-owner 2008 Deere 6630 at Tottenham on 23 Oct, and the Pickles Kubota M108S closing tonight at $8,100. Chainsaws keep turning over around Melbourne at $950-1,600. Trailers, troughs, portable homes and the Mac mini are quiet.
headlines: New: 2008 JD 6630, 130hp, 1,552 hrs, JD 741 loader, one owner. Tottenham clearing sale 23 Oct, no premium, about 390 km.
Pickles 2021 Kubota M108S loader at $8,100 after 35 bids, closes 6:30pm tonight. 3,621 hrs, no cab.
Husqvarna 395 XP with new 25in bar back at $1,200 in Melbourne; Wallan MS 461 and Wollert MS 462 gone.
New: crated 24-plate offset discs at Seymour, $7,890, 2.5 m, rated 70-100hp, 330 km.
New: boxed Warn Zeon 10-S, $1,500 at Point Cook; Tatura VR Evo 10-S still the pick at $900.
Quiet: no change on trailer, dog trough, portable home or Mac mini.
